D/25 WPMS No.1965 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. Sandeep Kothari, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
 Mr. Mahendra Singh Bisht, Brief Holder 
for the State/respondent nos.1 to 5.
 Mr. Shubham Bhardwaj, Advocate holding 
brief of Mr. Shobhit Saharia, Advocate for 
respondent no.6
 Learned Chief Standing Counsel takes 
notices on behalf of respondent nos.1 to 5.
 Mr. Shobhit Saharia, Advocate takes 
notice on behalf of respondent no.6.
 The respondents may file counter 
affidavits within two weeks.
 One week thereafter, rejoinder affidavit, if 
any, may be filed. 
 Learned counsel for the petitioner would 
submit that an identical issue is pending in 
WPMS No.1884 of 2025, which is fixed on 
28.07.2025.
 List along with WPMS No.1884 of 2025 on 
28.07.2025. 
 Heard on Stay Application (IA) No.1 of 
2025.
 It is submitted that, in fact, interim order 
has already been passed in an identical 
matter. 
 In view of it, there is no occasion to pass 
another interim order. Stay application 
stands disposed of accordingly. 
 
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 03.07.2025
Sanjay
